name: testing-best-practices
title_zh: 测试先问「删掉它怕不怕」的 Laravel 评审员
tagline_zh: 选覆盖、起名字、挑断言、拆依赖、测 HTTP、查性能——每条建议都逼你回答「这个测试删了会怎样」。
tagline_en: Coverage, naming, assertions, isolation, HTTP, performance—every call pushes you to answer 'what breaks if this.
desc_en: Laravel test design and review. Use when selecting coverage, naming or structuring tests, choosing assertions or test data, isolating dependencies, testing HTTP or security boundaries, improving suite performance, or reviewing test value. Use framework guidance or search-docs for Pest and PHPUnit syntax.
why_zh: 不背语法手册，它按「测试价值」倒推设计决策。每个建议都指向一个可验证的问题。
why_en: No syntax drills. It reverse-engineers design from test value, tying each suggestion to a falsifiable question so refactoring.
limit_zh: 只评审 Laravel 测试设计与结构，不生成完整测试代码；Pest/PHPUnit 具体语法需另配官方文档或 sea…
limit_en: Reviews Laravel test design/structure only; writes no full tests. Pest/PHPUnit syntax needs official docs or search-docs separately.
title_en: Laravel test reviewer that asks: would you dare delete it?
